svg.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: The Real Part and One Bit · Figure 3 · Steps 1 To 3 · The Floor, The Prime Side And The Strip
svg.text: FIGURE 3
STEPS 1 TO 3 · THE FLOOR, THE PRIME SIDE AND THE STRIP
RH: THE REAL PART AND ONE BIT · MASTER v3.0.39_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 1 · FOUNDATION · INDEPENDENCE BLOCKED, THE FLOOR PROVED
FORMAL-ALONE
A Σ₁-complete sound theory proves what computation settles, and a Π⁰₁
hypothesis it cannot refute is sealed true. The root holds on the world on the line
and on the world off it, so it does not cross the line; the six-route ledger is
computed from three bits.

svg.text: PHYSICO-FORMAL
The floor is the self-grounding root: every act re-enacts it, it is a theorem on the
constructed domain, and freedom, the identity arrow, is inhabited. A universal
floor stands on both worlds of the bit, so it forces no value.

STEP 2 · THE PRIME SIDE · A FREE BASIS AND A MULTIPLICATIVE ARROW
FORMAL-ALONE
Every prime is a two-state fibre of multiplication; Euclid's lemma by least-witness
descent; two completely additive functions agreeing at the primes agree
everywhere, and every assignment extends uniquely: the primes are a free
basis. λ is completely multiplicative.

svg.text: PHYSICO-FORMAL
Prime freedom and the arrows force nothing: the basis holds on an explicit
formula with positive Weil functional and on one without. The aperture opens
one bit wide, and it does not spend the sign.

svg.text: GRADE · theorem, unconditional; the aperture ∅, the arithmetic and its keylessness pQ
STEP 3 · THE CRITICAL-LINE HINGE AND THE STRIP
FORMAL-ALONE
From Mathlib's analysis alone: ζ has no zero on Re s ≥ 1,
and the reflection carries the bound across, so every
nontrivial zero lies in 0 < Re s < 1. The zeros are fold-closed
and equal to the completed zeros; an off-line zero has a twin
in the band 1/2 < Re s < 1, so RH is exactly the zero-free
band.

svg.text: PHYSICO-FORMAL
Registration is the midpoint of a point and its fold image.
Every zero's pair has its midpoint in the record; each zero
coinciding with its midpoint is exactly RH, and so is
Re s ≤ 1/2 at every zero. The carrier embeds in ℂ:
conjugation to the fold, annihilation to registration.
